guide.summary: 在 or 正在 before a verb, or 呢 at the end of the sentence, says the action is going on at the moment you are talking about. It is not a tense: the time word decides whether that moment is now, yesterday or tomorrow. The click: 在 + verb = in the middle of doing; 在 + place = located at. No 了, no 'to be', and no 在 with states like 知道 or 喜欢.

subs.label: 在 / 正在 + verb
subs.focus: Force 在 / 正在 straight before the verb, after subject, time word and 也 / 都, with no 是 for 'am/is'. Classic errors: 我是吃饭, 我在现在吃饭, marker at the end, or no marker for a clear '-ing right now'. Never offer 在 and 正在 as rival options here.

subs.label: Sentence-final 呢 and 正在…呢
subs.focus: Force 呢 at the very end of a statement as the ongoing marker, alone (他睡觉呢) or with 在 / 正在 (我正在吃饭呢). Classic errors: 呢 mid-sentence, picking 吗 / 吧 / 了 / 的, or believing 正在 and 呢 cannot co-occur. Use statements only, never 'and you?' questions.

subs.label: Negating with 没(在)
subs.focus: Force 没(有) to negate an action in progress (我没在看电视), dropping 正 and 呢; short answer 没有. Classic errors: keeping 了, answering 不是, 不正在. 没正在 is sometimes said: cloze distractor only, never the sole error in a judge item. Bare 不在 + verb is accepted by some: never the only wrong thing in an item.

subs.label: In progress in the past or future
subs.focus: Force unchanged 在 / 正在 for an action in progress at a past or future moment set by a time word or …的时候 clause, with no 了 / 过. Classic errors: 你来的时候我洗澡了 or 我正在看了电视 for 'was doing', and doubting 正在 can go with 昨天 or 明天.

subs.label: 在 or 正在?
subs.focus: Force plain 在 after 一直, 还, 总是, 经常, 每天 (continuing or repeated activity); 正在 fits only one exact moment. Classic errors: 他一直正在等你, 她还正在睡觉. Each item needs such an adverb so 正在 is clearly out; do not test 最近 / 这几天, where both are heard.

subs.label: 在: in progress, place phrase, or main verb
subs.focus: Force the reading of 在 from what follows: verb = in progress, place + verb = where, place alone = 'be at' (negated 不在). Place goes before the verb; one 在 only when place and progressive meet. Classic errors: 我看书在图书馆, 他正在在家看电视, 他是在家. Do not mark 没在 + place wrong.

subs.label: Verbs that cannot be in progress
subs.focus: Force leaving 在 / 正在 out with state verbs: 知道, 是, 有, 喜欢, 认识, 觉得, 姓, 像. Classic errors from English '-ing' or 'right now': 我在知道, 我正在喜欢他, 他正在有时间. Use ∅ options or judge items. Do not treat 想, 考虑 or 忙 as banned: they can take 在.

subs.label: No 了, 过, result or duration with 在
subs.focus: Force a bare verb after 在 / 正在: no verb 了 / 过, no result complement, no duration; 'have been doing for X' becomes verb + 了 + duration + 了. Classic errors: 我正在看了书, 我在写完作业, 我在学中文两年. Do not test 已经在…了 (correct) or treat 着 as wrong.

rules.rule: Put 在 or 正在 right before the verb to say the action is under way. There is no word for 'am/is/are' here: do not add 是.
rules.pattern: Subject + 在 / 正在 + Verb + Object

rules.note: Chinese often leaves the marker out when the context is clear, but when the English cue says '-ing right now', use it.

rules.rule: Time words and adverbs such as 也, 都 and 现在 come before 在 / 正在, never between it and the verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + time / 也 / 都 + 在 / 正在 + Verb + Object

examples.py: tóng xué men dōu zài zhǔn bèi kǎo shì

rules.rule: In speech, 呢 at the very end of a statement can show the action is going on, even with no 在.

examples.py: wǒ chī fàn ne
examples.en: I'm eating.

examples.zh: 他睡觉呢，你小声一点儿。
examples.py: tā shuì jiào ne nǐ xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r
examples.en: He's sleeping, keep your voice down.

examples.py: bié jìn qù tā men kāi huì ne
examples.en: Don't go in, they're in a meeting.

rules.note: This 呢 is casual and spoken. It is a different use from the question 呢 in 你呢？

rules.rule: 呢 combines freely with 在 or 正在; the marker goes before the verb and 呢 stays at the end.
rules.pattern: Subject + 在 / 正在 + Verb + Object + 呢

examples.py: wǒ zhèng zài xǐ zǎo ne
examples.en: I'm in the middle of a shower.

examples.py: hái zi men zài kàn diàn shì ne
examples.en: The kids are watching television.

examples.zh: 等一下，我正在找钥匙呢。
examples.py: děng yī xià wǒ zhèng zài zhǎo yào shi ne
examples.en: Hang on, I'm looking for my keys.

rules.rule: To say an action is not in progress, use 没 or 没有, with or without 在. 正 and 呢 disappear. The short answer is 没有.

examples.py: wǒ méi zài kàn diàn shì
examples.en: I'm not watching television.

examples.zh: 他没在睡觉，他在玩手机。
examples.py: tā méi zài shuì jiào tā zài wán shǒu jī
examples.en: He isn't sleeping, he's on his phone.

examples.py: méi yǒu wǒ zài xiě zuò yè
examples.en: No, I'm doing my homework.

rules.note: 正 normally drops in the negative: 不正在 is not used, and 没正在 is occasionally heard but is not standard. To correct what someone thinks you are doing, 不是在 is also used: 我不是在玩，我是在工作. Some speakers say 不在 + verb, but 没在 is the safe form.

rules.rule: 在 / 正在 has no tense. Set the moment with a time word or a …的时候 clause and keep the verb exactly as for 'now': no 了.
rules.pattern: Time / Clause + 的时候 + Subject + 在 / 正在 + Verb + Object

examples.zh: 昨天你来的时候，我正在洗澡。
examples.py: zuó tiān nǐ lái de shí hou wǒ zhèng zài xǐ zǎo
examples.en: When you came by yesterday, I was in the shower.

examples.zh: 昨天晚上八点我在写作业。
examples.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang bā diǎn wǒ zài xiě zuò yè
examples.en: At eight last night I was doing my homework.

examples.zh: 他进来的时候，我们正在吃晚饭。
examples.py: tā jìn lái de shí hou wǒ men zhèng zài chī wǎn fàn
examples.en: When he came in, we were having dinner.

examples.zh: 明天这个时候我可能正在开会。
examples.py: míng tiān zhè ge shí hou wǒ kě néng zhèng zài kāi huì
examples.en: This time tomorrow I'll probably be in a meeting.

rules.rule: 正在 points at one exact moment. For something that keeps going or keeps happening (一直, 还, 总是, 经常, 每天), use plain 在.
rules.pattern: Subject + 一直 / 还 / 总是 + 在 + Verb + Object

examples.py: tā yī zhí zài děng nǐ
examples.en: He has been waiting for you the whole time.

examples.zh: 已经十点了，她还在睡觉。
examples.py: yǐ jīng shí diǎn le tā hái zài shuì jiào
examples.en: It's already ten and she is still sleeping.

examples.py: wǒ dì di zǒng shì zài wán yóu xì
examples.en: My little brother is always playing games.

rules.note: With no such adverb, 在 and 正在 are usually both fine; 正在 just adds 'right at this moment'. With 最近 or 这几天 both are heard.

rules.rule: Look at what follows 在. A verb: in progress. A place and then a verb: where the action happens. A place and nothing more: 在 is the main verb 'to be at', negated with 不.
rules.pattern: 在 + Verb / 在 + Place + Verb / 在 + Place

examples.py: tā zài kàn shū
examples.en: He is reading.

examples.py: tā zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū
examples.en: He reads / is reading in the library.

examples.py: tā zài tú shū guǎn
examples.en: He is at the library.

examples.py: lǐ lǎo shī bù zài bàn gōng shì
examples.en: Teacher Li is not in the office.

rules.note: 在 + place + verb by itself can be a habit or right now. Add 正 or 呢 to make 'right now' unmistakable.

rules.rule: The place phrase goes before the verb, and one 在 does both jobs: never 在在 or 正在在. Use 正在 + place, or add 呢.

examples.py: wǒ zhèng zài chāo shì mǎi dōng xi
examples.en: I'm at the supermarket buying things right now.

examples.py: tā zài chú fáng zuò fàn ne
examples.en: She is cooking in the kitchen.

examples.zh: 孩子们正在公园里踢足球。
examples.py: hái zi men zhèng zài gōng yuán lǐ tī zú qiú
examples.en: The children are playing football in the park right now.

rules.rule: Verbs for states, not activities, never take 在 / 正在: 知道, 是, 有, 喜欢, 认识, 觉得. English '-ing' or 'right now' does not change this; use 现在 if you need 'now'.

examples.py: wǒ zhī dào tā de míng zi
examples.en: I know his name.

examples.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè ge diàn yǐng
examples.en: I'm really liking this film.

examples.py: tā xiàn zài yǒu shí jiān
examples.en: He has time right now.

examples.py: tā xiàn zài shì lǎo shī
examples.en: She is a teacher now.

rules.note: Thinking as an activity is fine with 在: 我在想一个问题 (I'm thinking about a problem).

rules.rule: After 在 / 正在 the verb stays bare: no 了 or 过 on the verb and no result complement, because the action is not finished yet.
rules.pattern: Subject + 在 / 正在 + bare Verb + Object

examples.py: wǒ zhèng zài kàn shū
examples.en: I'm reading.

examples.py: wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de shǒu jī
examples.en: I'm looking for my phone.

examples.py: tā zài xiě zuò yè hái méi xiě wán
examples.en: He is doing his homework and hasn't finished yet.

rules.note: 着 is allowed after the verb (他正在等着你呢), and sentence-final 了 can follow 已经在 to mean 'already at it' (他已经在睡觉了).

rules.rule: 在 cannot take a 'how long' phrase. For 'have been doing for X', say verb + 了 + duration (+ object) + 了.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 了 + duration + (的) + Object + 了

examples.py: wǒ xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén le
examples.en: I have been studying Chinese for two years.

examples.py: wǒ děng le nǐ bàn ge xiǎo shí le
examples.en: I've been waiting for you for half an hour.

examples.zh: 他看了三个小时的电视了。
examples.py: tā kàn le sān ge xiǎo shí de diàn shì le
examples.en: He has been watching television for three hours.

contrasts.why: English 'am' is not 是 here. The '-ing' meaning is carried by 在 before the verb.

right.py: wǒ méi zài kàn diàn shì

contrasts.why: An action in progress is negated with 没, and 正 drops out. 不正在 is not a form speakers use.

contrasts.wrong: 昨天你来的时候，我洗澡了。

right.zh: 昨天你来的时候，我正在洗澡。
right.py: zuó tiān nǐ lái de shí hou wǒ zhèng zài xǐ zǎo
right.en: When you came by yesterday, I was in the shower.

contrasts.why: 'Was showering' is in progress at a past moment, so it takes 正在. 了 would say the shower happened, not that it was under way when you arrived.

right.py: wǒ zhèng zài kàn yī běn shū

contrasts.why: 正在 means not finished; 了 after the verb means completed. They cannot share one verb.

right.py: tā yī zhí zài děng nǐ
right.en: He has been waiting for you the whole time.

contrasts.why: 正在 marks one exact moment and clashes with 一直 'all along'. Plain 在 is used for something that keeps going.

right.py: wǒ zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū

contrasts.why: The place phrase with 在 goes before the verb, not at the end as in English.

right.py: tā zhèng zài jiā kàn diàn shì
right.en: He is watching television at home right now.

contrasts.why: One 在 serves as both 'at' and 'in progress'. Two in a row are never said; 正 or a final 呢 shows it is happening now.

right.py: wǒ zhī dào tā de míng zi

contrasts.why: 知道 is a state, not an activity you are in the middle of, so it cannot take 在.

right.py: wǒ xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén le
right.en: I have been studying Chinese for two years.

contrasts.why: 在 cannot carry a duration. 'Have been doing for X' is verb + 了 + duration + 了.

contrasts.wrong: 我正在很喜欢这个电影。

right.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè ge diàn yǐng

contrasts.why: 喜欢 is a state, so 'I'm liking it' is just 喜欢 with no 正在.

cheat: '-ing right now'? 在 or 正在 straight before the verb. No 是.
After 在: verb = doing it; place + verb = where; place alone = is there.
Not doing it: 没(在) + verb. Not there: 不在 + place. Drop 正 in the negative.
'Was doing' = time word + 正在. Do not add 了.
一直 / 还 / 总是 in the sentence? Plain 在, not 正在.
知道, 是, 有, 喜欢, 认识: no 在, ever.
After 在 the verb is bare: no 了, no 过, no 完 / 到, no 'for two years'.

items.q: 妈妈___做饭，你先看电视吧。
items.zh: 妈妈在做饭，你先看电视吧。
items.py: mā ma zài zuò fàn nǐ xiān kàn diàn shì ba
items.en: Mum is cooking, so watch TV for now.
items.why: 在 goes right before the verb to say the cooking is under way. 是 is not the 'is' of 'is cooking', and 有 or 把 cannot sit in front of 做饭 like this.

items.q: 爸爸现在___看报纸。
items.zh: 爸爸现在在看报纸。
items.py: bà ba xiàn zài zài kàn bào zhǐ
items.en: Dad is reading the newspaper now.
items.why: 现在 comes first, then 在 directly before the verb. 是 only copies English 'is', and 很 cannot modify an action like 看报纸.

items.q: 哥哥也___洗车。
items.zh: 哥哥也在洗车。
items.py: gē ge yě zài xǐ chē
items.en: My older brother is washing the car too.
items.why: 也 comes before 在, and 在 comes before the verb 洗车. 了 would sit after a verb, not in front of one.

items.q: 他们都___准备搬家。
items.zh: 他们都在准备搬家。
items.py: tā men dōu zài zhǔn bèi bān jiā
items.en: They are all getting ready to move house.
items.why: 都 goes before 在, and 在 stands right before the verb 准备 to show the preparing is in progress. 把, 有 and 到 do not form a progressive.

items.q: 我弟弟正___写作业，别吵他。
items.zh: 我弟弟正在写作业，别吵他。
items.py: wǒ dì di zhèng zài xiě zuò yè bié chǎo tā
items.en: My younger brother is doing his homework, don't bother him.
items.why: 正 needs 在 to make 正在 before the verb. 正是, 正有 and 正着 are not a progressive marker.

items.q: 路上很堵，司机们都___按喇叭。
items.zh: 路上很堵，司机们都在按喇叭。
items.py: lù shang hěn dǔ sī jī men dōu zài àn lǎ ba
items.en: The road is jammed and the drivers are all honking their horns.
items.why: 都 then 在 then the verb: the honking is happening right now. 是, 把 and 给 cannot introduce 按喇叭 as an action in progress.

items.q: 我听见楼上的邻居___搬家具，吵得我睡不着。
items.zh: 我听见楼上的邻居在搬家具，吵得我睡不着。
items.py: wǒ tīng jiàn lóu shàng de lín jū zài bān jiā jù chǎo de wǒ shuì bù zháo
items.en: I can hear the upstairs neighbour moving furniture, and the noise keeps me awake.
items.why: 在 before 搬家具 shows the moving is going on while I listen. 是, 有 and 被 do not mark a happening action here, and 被 would need the furniture as subject.

items.q: 我们俩都___等对方先开口，所以谁也没说话。
items.zh: 我们俩都在等对方先开口，所以谁也没说话。
items.py: wǒ men liǎ dōu zài děng duì fāng xiān kāi kǒu suǒ yǐ shéi yě méi shuō huà
items.en: We were both waiting for the other to speak first, so neither of us said anything.
items.why: 都 then 在 then 等: both were in the middle of waiting. 有, 把 and 被 cannot stand before a plain verb to say this.

items.q: 你小声点，宝宝睡觉___。
items.zh: 你小声点，宝宝睡觉呢。
items.py: nǐ xiǎo shēng diǎn bǎo bao shuì jiào ne
items.en: Keep it down, the baby is sleeping.
items.why: Sentence-final 呢 marks a statement as 'going on right now'. 吗 turns it into a question and 吧 into a suggestion or guess; 的 does not complete it.

items.q: 别关电视，爸爸看新闻___。
items.zh: 别关电视，爸爸看新闻呢。
items.py: bié guān diàn shì bà ba kàn xīn wén ne
items.en: Don't turn off the TV, Dad is watching the news.
items.why: 呢 at the end shows Dad is in the middle of watching. 过 would mean he has watched it before, and 吗 would ask a question.

items.q: 妹妹在厨房洗菜___。
items.zh: 妹妹在厨房洗菜呢。
items.py: mèi mei zài chú fáng xǐ cài ne
items.en: My younger sister is washing vegetables in the kitchen.
items.why: The statement of an ongoing action ends in 呢. 吗 would make it a question, and 过 after the object is not possible.

items.q: 你先别进去，他们正在开会___。
items.zh: 你先别进去，他们正在开会呢。
items.py: nǐ xiān bié jìn qù tā men zhèng zài kāi huì ne
items.en: Don't go in yet, they're in a meeting right now.
items.why: 正在 and final 呢 happily go together to stress it is under way. 了 clashes with 正在, 吗 makes a question, and 过 does not end a sentence.

items.q: 等一下，我正在找钥匙___，马上就好。
items.zh: 等一下，我正在找钥匙呢，马上就好。
items.py: děng yī xià wǒ zhèng zài zhǎo yào shi ne mǎ shàng jiù hǎo
items.en: Hang on, I'm looking for my keys, it'll be a moment.
items.why: 呢 closes the clause to say the search is still going on. 吗 would ask a question, and 了 would suggest the search is over, which contradicts 马上就好.

items.q: 孩子们还在楼下玩___，还没回来。
items.zh: 孩子们还在楼下玩呢，还没回来。
items.py: hái zi men hái zài lóu xià wán ne hái méi huí lái
items.en: The kids are still playing downstairs, they haven't come back.
items.why: 还在 plus final 呢 describes what is still going on. 了 would say the playing is over, which clashes with 还没回来, and 吗 is a question marker.

items.q: 你不用打电话了，奶奶和爷爷正在公园里散步___，晚点儿就回来。
items.zh: 你不用打电话了，奶奶和爷爷正在公园里散步呢，晚点儿就回来。
items.py: nǐ bù yòng dǎ diàn huà le nǎi nai hé yé ye zhèng zài gōng yuán lǐ sàn bù ne wǎn diǎn r jiù huí lái
items.en: No need to call, Grandma and Grandpa are out for a walk in the park, they'll be back later.
items.why: 呢 at the end of the first clause says the walk is going on. 吗 would ask a question, 过 cannot end a clause, and 的 does not fit.

items.q: 我___在看电视，我在看书。
items.zh: 我没在看电视，我在看书。
items.py: wǒ méi zài kàn diàn shì wǒ zài kàn shū
items.en: I'm not watching TV, I'm reading.
items.why: An action in progress is negated with 没 before 在. 没正 and 不正 do not exist because 正 drops out, and 别 is an order, not a statement.

items.q: 弟弟___在睡觉，他在玩游戏。
items.zh: 弟弟没在睡觉，他在玩游戏。
items.py: dì di méi zài shuì jiào tā zài wán yóu xì
items.en: My younger brother isn't sleeping, he's playing a game.
items.why: 没 plus 在 denies the in-progress action. 不正在 and 没正在 are never said, and 别 is a command.

items.q: 你在做饭吗？___，我在洗衣服。
items.zh: 你在做饭吗？没有，我在洗衣服。
items.py: nǐ zài zuò fàn ma méi yǒu wǒ zài xǐ yī fu
items.en: Are you cooking? No, I'm washing clothes.
items.why: The short answer to a 在-question is 没有. 不正在 and 没正在 are not real forms because 正 disappears in the negative.

items.q: 爸爸___在客厅看电视，他在书房工作。
items.zh: 爸爸没在客厅看电视，他在书房工作。
items.py: bà ba méi zài kè tīng kàn diàn shì tā zài shū fáng gōng zuò
items.en: Dad isn't watching TV in the living room, he's working in the study.
items.why: Denying an activity that would be happening uses 没 before 在. 不正 and 没正 do not exist, and 别 is an imperative.

items.q: 我们___在排队买票，我们刚到。
items.zh: 我们没在排队买票，我们刚到。
items.py: wǒ men méi zài pái duì mǎi piào wǒ men gāng dào
items.en: We aren't queuing for tickets, we've just arrived.
items.why: 没 + 在 negates the in-progress action. Once negated, 正 cannot stay, so 没正 and 不正 fail, and 别 is a command.

items.q: 你是不是在玩手机？___，我在查地图。
items.zh: 你是不是在玩手机？没有，我在查地图。
items.py: nǐ shì bu shì zài wán shǒu jī méi yǒu wǒ zài chá dì tú
items.en: Are you playing on your phone? No, I'm checking the map.
items.why: 没有 is the clean denial of an in-progress action. 不正在 and 没正在 mix 正 with a negative, which Chinese never does.

items.q: 你别以为我在偷懒，我___在休息，我在想怎么修这台洗衣机。
items.zh: 你别以为我在偷懒，我没在休息，我在想怎么修这台洗衣机。
items.py: nǐ bié yǐ wéi wǒ zài tōu lǎn wǒ méi zài xiū xi wǒ zài xiǎng zěn me xiū zhè tái xǐ yī jī
items.en: Don't think I'm slacking off, I'm not resting, I'm thinking about how to fix this washing machine.
items.why: To deny 在休息 you say 没在休息. 不正 and 没正 are not forms, and 别 would turn the clause into a command to yourself.

items.q: 昨天你打电话的时候，我___洗澡。
items.zh: 昨天你打电话的时候，我正在洗澡。
items.py: zuó tiān nǐ dǎ diàn huà de shí hou wǒ zhèng zài xǐ zǎo
items.en: When you called yesterday, I was in the shower.
items.why: The shower was in progress at a past moment, so 正在 goes before the verb, with no tense change. 了 and 过 cannot stand before 洗澡 and would not say 'was in the middle of'.

items.q: 昨天晚上八点，妈妈___做饭。
items.zh: 昨天晚上八点，妈妈在做饭。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang bā diǎn mā ma zài zuò fàn
items.en: At eight last night Mum was cooking.
items.why: 在 works for a past moment fixed by 昨天晚上八点. 了 and 过 before the verb are impossible, and 是 is not 'was' here.

items.q: 明天晚上七点我___开会，不能接电话。
items.zh: 明天晚上七点我在开会，不能接电话。
items.py: míng tiān wǎn shang qī diǎn wǒ zài kāi huì bù néng jiē diàn huà
items.en: I'll be in a meeting at seven tomorrow evening, so I can't answer the phone.
items.why: 在 has no tense, so it also covers a future moment set by 明天晚上七点. 把, 是 and 了 cannot precede 开会 to give 'will be in the middle of'.

items.q: 我给你打电话的时候，你___在做什么？
items.zh: 我给你打电话的时候，你正在做什么？
items.py: wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de shí hou nǐ zhèng zài zuò shén me
items.en: What were you doing when I called you?
items.why: 'What were you in the middle of?' is 正在 with the unchanged verb. 了 and 过 cannot be placed before 在, and 有在 is not a pattern.

items.q: 地铁到站的时候，很多人___站台上等车。
items.zh: 地铁到站的时候，很多人正在站台上等车。
items.py: dì tiě dào zhàn de shí hou hěn duō rén zhèng zài zhàn tái shàng děng chē
items.en: When the train pulled in, a lot of people were waiting on the platform.
items.why: 正在 + place + verb says what was under way at the moment of arrival. 了, 过 and 着 cannot take the place of the 在 that introduces 站台上.

items.q: 昨天警察来的时候，邻居们都___院子里聊天。
items.zh: 昨天警察来的时候，邻居们都正在院子里聊天。
items.py: zuó tiān jǐng chá lái de shí hou lín jū men dōu zhèng zài yuàn zi lǐ liáo tiān
items.en: When the police came yesterday, the neighbours were all chatting in the yard.
items.why: The chatting was in progress when the police arrived, so 正在 before the place. 了, 过 and 着 cannot stand there and would not give the 'was in the middle of' reading.

items.q: 我们昨天到的时候，他们已经___吃饭了，所以我们没打扰他们。
items.zh: 我们昨天到的时候，他们已经在吃饭了，所以我们没打扰他们。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān dào de shí hou tā men yǐ jīng zài chī fàn le suǒ yǐ wǒ men méi dǎ rǎo tā men
items.en: When we arrived yesterday they were already eating, so we didn't disturb them.
items.why: 已经在 + verb + 了 means 'was already at it'. 了, 过 and 是 cannot stand between 已经 and the verb to say that.

items.q: 奶奶一直___等你，快去看看她吧。
items.zh: 奶奶一直在等你，快去看看她吧。
items.py: nǎi nai yī zhí zài děng nǐ kuài qù kàn kan tā ba
items.en: Grandma has been waiting for you all along, go and see her.
items.why: 一直 stretches the waiting over a period, so plain 在 is used. 正在 pins one exact moment and clashes with 一直.

items.q: 已经十点了，哥哥还___睡觉。
items.zh: 已经十点了，哥哥还在睡觉。
items.py: yǐ jīng shí diǎn le gē ge hái zài shuì jiào
items.en: It's already ten and my older brother is still sleeping.
items.why: 还 means the sleeping continues, so plain 在 follows it. 还正在 is not said, and 了 or 是 cannot follow 还 here.

items.q: 我妹妹总是___玩手机，不爱看书。
items.zh: 我妹妹总是在玩手机，不爱看书。
items.py: wǒ mèi mei zǒng shì zài wán shǒu jī bù ài kàn shū
items.en: My younger sister is always on her phone and doesn't like reading.
items.why: 总是 describes a repeated habit, so plain 在. 正在 means one exact moment and cannot go with 总是.

items.q: 爷爷每天早上都___打太极拳。
items.zh: 爷爷每天早上都在打太极拳。
items.py: yé ye měi tiān zǎo shang dōu zài dǎ tài jí quán
items.en: Grandpa does tai chi every morning.
items.why: 每天 makes it a repeated activity, so plain 在 is right. 正在 is for a single moment, and 过 or 着 cannot stand before 打.

items.q: 你怎么还___睡？太阳都出来了。
items.zh: 你怎么还在睡？太阳都出来了。
items.py: nǐ zěn me hái zài shuì tài yáng dōu chū lái le
items.en: How come you're still asleep? The sun is already up.
items.why: 还 + 在 says the sleeping is still going on. 还正在 is not said, and 是 or 有 cannot follow 还 to express 'still asleep'.

items.q: 他经常___想回老家，因为他很想念父母。
items.zh: 他经常在想回老家，因为他很想念父母。
items.py: tā jīng cháng zài xiǎng huí lǎo jiā yīn wèi tā hěn xiǎng niàn fù mǔ
items.en: He often finds himself thinking about going back to his hometown, because he misses his parents.
items.why: 经常 describes something that keeps happening, so plain 在. 正在 is for one moment only, and 了 or 过 cannot stand before 想.

items.q: 我从早上到现在一直___找那家饭馆，可是还没找到。
items.zh: 我从早上到现在一直在找那家饭馆，可是还没找到。
items.py: wǒ cóng zǎo shang dào xiàn zài yī zhí zài zhǎo nà jiā fàn guǎn kě shì hái méi zhǎo dào
items.en: I've been looking for that restaurant from the morning until now, and I still haven't found it.
items.why: 一直 plus a long span means a continuing activity, so plain 在. 正在 pins a single moment, and 了 or 过 cannot follow 一直 directly.

items.q: 妈妈不___家，她去超市了。
items.zh: 妈妈不在家，她去超市了。
items.py: mā ma bù zài jiā tā qù chāo shì le
items.en: Mum isn't at home, she's gone to the supermarket.
items.why: 在 + place alone means 'be at', negated with 不 before 在. 不是家, 不有家 and 不去家 do not say 'not at home'.

items.q: 奶奶___公园里散步。
items.zh: 奶奶在公园里散步。
items.py: nǎi nai zài gōng yuán lǐ sàn bù
items.en: Grandma is walking in the park.
items.why: 在 + place + verb says where the action happens, and the place goes before the verb. 是, 有 and 给 cannot introduce 公园里.

items.q: 我哥哥___图书馆学习。
items.zh: 我哥哥在图书馆学习。
items.py: wǒ gē ge zài tú shū guǎn xué xí
items.en: My older brother is studying in the library.
items.why: 在 introduces the location before the verb 学习. 对, 是 and 有 do not introduce a place of action.

items.q: 李老师___在办公室，你去楼下的教室找她。
items.zh: 李老师不在办公室，你去楼下的教室找她。
items.py: lǐ lǎo shī bù zài bàn gōng shì nǐ qù lóu xià de jiào shì zhǎo tā
items.en: Teacher Li isn't in the office, go and look for her in the classroom downstairs.
items.why: 在 as a main verb ('be at') is negated by 不. 很 and 别 do not negate 在, and 还 would say she is still there, which contradicts the second clause.

items.q: 他___教室里等你，你快去吧。
items.zh: 他正在教室里等你，你快去吧。
items.py: tā zhèng zài jiào shì lǐ děng nǐ nǐ kuài qù ba
items.en: He's waiting for you in the classroom right now, so hurry.
items.why: One 在 does both jobs, 'in the classroom' and 'in progress', so it is 正在 and never a doubled 在. 正在在, 在在 and 有在 are all unusable.

items.q: 孩子们都___小区的花园里踢球，只有小王一个人在家写作业。
items.zh: 孩子们都在小区的花园里踢球，只有小王一个人在家写作业。
items.py: hái zi men dōu zài xiǎo qū de huā yuán lǐ tī qiú zhǐ yǒu xiǎo wáng yī ge rén zài jiā xiě zuò yè
items.en: The kids are all playing football in the neighbourhood garden, only Xiao Wang is at home doing homework.
items.why: 在 + place before the verb gives where the kicking happens. 对, 是 and 有 cannot introduce 小区的花园里 as a location.

items.q: 我昨天到家的时候，爸爸不___家，他在楼下的超市买东西。
items.zh: 我昨天到家的时候，爸爸不在家，他在楼下的超市买东西。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān dào jiā de shí hou bà ba bù zài jiā tā zài lóu xià de chāo shì mǎi dōng xi
items.en: When I got home yesterday Dad wasn't there, he was at the supermarket downstairs buying things.
items.why: 不在家 is the main-verb 在, 'not be at home', with 不. 不是家, 不有家 and 不会家 cannot mean this.

items.q: 我___知道他的电话号码。
items.zh: 我知道他的电话号码。
items.py: wǒ zhī dào tā de diàn huà hào mǎ
items.en: I know his phone number.
items.why: 知道 is a state, not an activity in progress, so no 在 or 正在 goes before it. Leave the blank empty.

items.q: 弟弟___喜欢这只小猫。
items.zh: 弟弟喜欢这只小猫。
items.py: dì di xǐ huan zhè zhī xiǎo māo
items.en: My younger brother likes this kitten.
items.why: 喜欢 is a feeling, not an action under way, so it takes neither 在 nor 正在. English 'is liking' does not carry over.

items.q: 我们家___有三个房间。
items.zh: 我们家有三个房间。
items.py: wǒ men jiā yǒu sān ge fáng jiān
items.en: Our home has three rooms.
items.why: 有 is a state and never takes 在 or 正在. The blank must stay empty.

items.q: 他现在___是我们班的班长。
items.zh: 他现在是我们班的班长。
items.py: tā xiàn zài shì wǒ men bān de bān zhǎng
items.en: He is our class monitor now.
items.why: 是 is not an action, so 在 and 正在 cannot go before it even with 现在. The time word alone says 'now'.

items.q: 我___觉得这个房子太小了，不太适合我们住。
items.zh: 我觉得这个房子太小了，不太适合我们住。
items.py: wǒ jué de zhè ge fáng zi tài xiǎo le bù tài shì hé wǒ men zhù
items.en: I think this flat is too small and doesn't really suit us.
items.why: 觉得 reports an opinion, a state, so no 在 or 正在 despite English 'I'm thinking'. Leave the blank empty.

items.q: 我不___知道楼下新搬来的邻居是做什么工作的，只听说他很有钱。
items.zh: 我不知道楼下新搬来的邻居是做什么工作的，只听说他很有钱。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào lóu xià xīn bān lái de lín jū shì zuò shén me gōng zuò de zhǐ tīng shuō tā hěn yǒu qián
items.en: I don't know what the new neighbour downstairs does for a living, I only heard he is rich.
items.why: 知道 is a state and never takes 在, not even when negated. So 不 sits directly against 知道.

items.q: 我正在写___作业，别跟我说话。
items.zh: 我正在写作业，别跟我说话。
items.py: wǒ zhèng zài xiě zuò yè bié gēn wǒ shuō huà
items.en: I'm doing my homework, don't talk to me.
items.why: After 正在 the verb stays bare. 了 would say the writing is done, 过 would mean experience, and both clash with 别跟我说话.

items.q: 爸爸在洗___碗，你去帮他吧。
items.zh: 爸爸在洗碗，你去帮他吧。
items.py: bà ba zài xǐ wǎn nǐ qù bāng tā ba
items.en: Dad is washing the dishes, go and help him.
items.why: The verb after 在 is bare. 了 or the result 完 would say the washing is finished, which contradicts 帮他.

items.q: 我在看___一部电影，你别关电视。
items.zh: 我在看一部电影，你别关电视。
items.py: wǒ zài kàn yī bù diàn yǐng nǐ bié guān diàn shì
items.en: I'm watching a film, don't turn off the TV.
items.why: In progress means not complete, so the verb takes no 了 or 过. 看了 would suggest the film is already watched and 看过 that I have seen it before.

items.q: 孩子们正在做___作业，还没做完。
items.zh: 孩子们正在做作业，还没做完。
items.py: hái zi men zhèng zài zuò zuò yè hái méi zuò wán
items.en: The kids are doing their homework and haven't finished yet.
items.why: After 正在 the verb stays bare. 做完 or 做了 would say the homework is finished, and 还没做完 states it is not.

items.q: 我等___你一个小时了，你怎么才来？
items.zh: 我等了你一个小时了，你怎么才来？
items.py: wǒ děng le nǐ yī ge xiǎo shí le nǐ zěn me cái lái
items.en: I've been waiting for you for an hour, why are you only just here?
items.why: 'Have been doing for an hour' is verb + 了 + duration + 了, never 在 plus a duration. 等在你 and 等过你 do not give 'have been waiting'.

items.q: 他陪奶奶在医院住___三天了，现在还没回家。
items.zh: 他陪奶奶在医院住了三天了，现在还没回家。
items.py: tā péi nǎi nai zài yī yuàn zhù le sān tiān le xiàn zài hái méi huí jiā
items.en: He has been staying at the hospital with Grandma for three days and still hasn't come home.
items.why: A duration that is still running uses 了 after the verb plus a final 了. 住着三天 and 住在三天 are not possible with a duration.

items.zh: 我们都在打扫房间。
items.py: wǒ men dōu zài dǎ sǎo fáng jiān
items.en: We are all cleaning the room.
items.why: 都 comes before 在, and 在 comes right before the verb. 在 cannot come before the subject or after the verb.

items.zh: 哥哥正在洗车。
items.py: gē ge zhèng zài xǐ chē
items.en: My older brother is washing the car right now.
items.why: The subject comes first, then 正在, then the verb. 正在 cannot go at the end.

items.zh: 孩子们在看电视呢。
items.py: hái zi men zài kàn diàn shì ne
items.en: The kids are watching TV.
items.why: 在 sits before the verb and 呢 stays at the very end. 呢 cannot sit mid-sentence.

items.zh: 我正在给奶奶打电话呢。
items.py: wǒ zhèng zài gěi nǎi nai dǎ diàn huà ne
items.en: I'm on the phone with Grandma right now.
items.why: 正在 comes before the whole 给奶奶打电话 phrase and 呢 closes the sentence. 给奶奶 stays before the verb.

items.zh: 我没在看电视。
items.py: wǒ méi zài kàn diàn shì
items.en: I'm not watching TV.
items.why: 没 goes before 在 and both come before the verb. 没 does not go at the end, and 正 is not added.

items.zh: 小王没在楼下等你。
items.py: xiǎo wáng méi zài lóu xià děng nǐ
items.en: Xiao Wang isn't waiting for you downstairs.
items.why: 没在 comes right after the subject, then the place, then the verb phrase. The place cannot move after the verb.

items.zh: 他进来的时候，我们正在吃晚饭。
items.py: tā jìn lái de shí hou wǒ men zhèng zài chī wǎn fàn
items.en: When he came in, we were having dinner.
items.why: The 的时候 clause sets the moment and comes first. The main clause then uses 正在 + verb, with no 了.

items.zh: 昨天晚上八点，爸爸在看电视。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang bā diǎn bà ba zài kàn diàn shì
items.en: At eight last night Dad was watching TV.
items.why: The time phrase can stand before or after the subject, but always before 在. 在 stays directly in front of the verb.

items.zh: 明天这个时候，我可能正在机场等朋友。
items.py: míng tiān zhè ge shí hou wǒ kě néng zhèng zài jī chǎng děng péng you
items.en: This time tomorrow I'll probably be at the airport waiting for a friend.
items.why: 正在 has no tense, so the future moment is set by the time phrase. 正在 + place + verb stays in this order.

items.zh: 哥哥一直在等朋友。
items.py: gē ge yī zhí zài děng péng you
items.en: My older brother has been waiting for his friend all along.
items.why: 一直 comes before 在 and the verb phrase follows. With 一直 the marker is plain 在.

items.zh: 李老师不在办公室，她正在教室上课。
items.py: lǐ lǎo shī bù zài bàn gōng shì tā zhèng zài jiào shì shàng kè
items.en: Teacher Li isn't in the office, she's teaching in the classroom right now.
items.why: 不在办公室 uses 在 as a main verb with 不. The second clause uses 正在 + place + verb, with the place before 上课.

items.zh: 他现在有时间。
items.py: tā xiàn zài yǒu shí jiān
items.en: He has time right now.
items.why: 有 is a state, so the tile 在 is not used. 现在 alone supplies 'right now', and it can go before or after the subject.

items.zh: 我正在看一本书。
items.py: wǒ zhèng zài kàn yī běn shū
items.en: I'm reading a book.
items.why: After 正在 the verb stays bare, so the tile 了 is not used. 了 would say the book has been read.

items.zh: 已经半夜了，邻居还在装修。
items.py: yǐ jīng bàn yè le lín jū hái zài zhuāng xiū
items.en: It's already midnight and the neighbours are still renovating.
items.why: 还 comes before 在, and 在 before the verb. 还 shows the activity continues, so plain 在 is used, not 正在.

items.src_py: mèi mei zài xǐ zǎo
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 妹妹没在洗澡。
items.py: mèi mei méi zài xǐ zǎo
items.en: My younger sister isn't taking a shower.
items.why: In-progress 在 is negated by putting 没 before it. 不 and 没正 are not used.

items.src_py: hái zi men zhèng zài wán yóu xì
items.task: Say they are not doing it.
items.zh: 孩子们没在玩游戏。
items.py: hái zi men méi zài wán yóu xì
items.en: The kids aren't playing games.
items.why: 正 drops out once 没 is added, so 正在 becomes 没在. 没正在 is not a form.

items.src_py: dì di chī píng guǒ
items.task: Say he is eating it right now, using 正在.
items.zh: 弟弟正在吃苹果。
items.py: dì di zhèng zài chī píng guǒ
items.en: My younger brother is eating an apple right now.
items.why: 正在 goes between the subject and the verb phrase to mark the action as under way.

items.src_py: wǒ men děng gōng gòng qì chē
items.task: Say we are in the middle of doing it, using 在.
items.zh: 我们在等公共汽车。
items.py: wǒ men zài děng gōng gòng qì chē
items.en: We're waiting for the bus.
items.why: 在 comes straight before the verb phrase. It does not go at the end of the sentence.

items.src_py: nǎi nai zài zuò fàn
items.task: Add 呢 to say it is going on right now.
items.zh: 奶奶在做饭呢。
items.py: nǎi nai zài zuò fàn ne
items.en: Grandma is cooking.
items.why: 呢 is added at the very end of the statement and the rest does not change.

items.src_py: jiě jie dǎ diàn huà
items.task: Say she is on the phone right now, using 正在 and 呢.
items.zh: 姐姐正在打电话呢。
items.py: jiě jie zhèng zài dǎ diàn huà ne
items.en: My older sister is on the phone right now.
items.why: 正在 goes before the verb phrase and 呢 closes the sentence. The two can appear together.

items.src: 他回家的时候，妈妈做饭了。
items.src_py: tā huí jiā de shí hou mā ma zuò fàn le
items.task: Say Mum was in the middle of cooking, using 正在.
items.zh: 他回家的时候，妈妈正在做饭。
items.py: tā huí jiā de shí hou mā ma zhèng zài zuò fàn
items.en: When he got home, Mum was cooking.
items.why: 'Was in the middle of' needs 正在 and a bare verb, and the 了 of the source sentence has to go.

items.src_py: wǒ zài děng nǐ bàn ge xiǎo shí
items.task: Fix it: say you have been waiting for half an hour.
items.zh: 我等了你半个小时了。
items.py: wǒ děng le nǐ bàn ge xiǎo shí le
items.en: I've been waiting for you for half an hour.
items.why: 在 cannot take a duration. 'Have been doing for X' is verb + 了 + duration + 了.

items.src_py: mèi mei zài wán shǒu jī
items.task: Say she is still doing it, using 还.
items.zh: 妹妹还在玩手机。
items.py: mèi mei hái zài wán shǒu jī
items.en: My younger sister is still playing on her phone.
items.why: 还 goes before 在 and keeps plain 在, because the activity is continuing.

items.src_py: wǒ kàn shū zài tú shū guǎn
items.task: Fix the word order.
items.zh: 我在图书馆看书。
items.py: wǒ zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū
items.en: I'm reading in the library.
items.why: The place phrase with 在 goes before the verb, not after the object. The place can also open the sentence.

items.s: 弟弟是写作业。
items.s_py: dì di shì xiě zuò yè
items.zh: 弟弟在写作业。
items.py: dì di zài xiě zuò yè
items.en: My younger brother is doing his homework.
items.why: 'Is doing' is 在 before the verb. 是 does not translate English 'is' here.

items.s: 爷爷看报纸在。
items.s_py: yé ye kàn bào zhǐ zài
items.zh: 爷爷在看报纸。
items.py: yé ye zài kàn bào zhǐ
items.en: Grandpa is reading the newspaper.
items.why: 在 goes before the verb, never at the end of the sentence.

items.s: 爸爸睡觉呢，你小声一点儿。
items.s_py: bà ba shuì jiào ne nǐ xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r
items.zh: 爸爸睡觉呢，你小声一点儿。
items.py: bà ba shuì jiào ne nǐ xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r
items.en: Dad is sleeping, keep your voice down.
items.why: Final 呢 alone can mark an action in progress, so no 在 is needed. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 妈妈不正在做饭。
items.s_py: mā ma bù zhèng zài zuò fàn
items.zh: 妈妈没在做饭。
items.py: mā ma méi zài zuò fàn
items.en: Mum isn't cooking.
items.why: An action in progress is negated with 没, and 正 drops out. 不正在 does not exist.

items.s: 我在喜欢这只小狗。
items.s_py: wǒ zài xǐ huan zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu
items.zh: 我喜欢这只小狗。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu
items.en: I like this puppy.
items.why: 喜欢 is a state and cannot take 在. English '-ing' is no reason to add it.

items.s: 他没在睡觉，他在玩手机。
items.s_py: tā méi zài shuì jiào tā zài wán shǒu jī
items.zh: 他没在睡觉，他在玩手机。
items.py: tā méi zài shuì jiào tā zài wán shǒu jī
items.en: He isn't sleeping, he's on his phone.
items.why: 没在 denies the first action and plain 在 states the second. This is correct.

items.s: 奶奶不在房间，她在院子里。
items.s_py: nǎi nai bù zài fáng jiān tā zài yuàn zi lǐ
items.zh: 奶奶不在房间，她在院子里。
items.py: nǎi nai bù zài fáng jiān tā zài yuàn zi lǐ
items.en: Grandma isn't in the room, she's in the yard.
items.why: 在 as a main verb is negated with 不, so 不在房间 is correct. It is not the progressive.

items.s: 你昨天打电话的时候，我正在路上开车。
items.s_py: nǐ zuó tiān dǎ diàn huà de shí hou wǒ zhèng zài lù shang kāi chē
items.zh: 你昨天打电话的时候，我正在路上开车。
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān dǎ diàn huà de shí hou wǒ zhèng zài lù shang kāi chē
items.en: When you called yesterday I was driving on the road.
items.why: 正在 works with 昨天 because it has no tense. This is correct.

items.s: 爷爷一直正在看新闻。
items.s_py: yé ye yī zhí zhèng zài kàn xīn wén
items.zh: 爷爷一直在看新闻。
items.py: yé ye yī zhí zài kàn xīn wén
items.en: Grandpa has been watching the news the whole time.
items.why: 一直 spreads the activity over time, which clashes with 正在 pointing at one moment. Use plain 在.

items.s: 孩子们踢足球在公园里。
items.s_py: hái zi men tī zú qiú zài gōng yuán lǐ
items.zh: 孩子们在公园里踢足球。
items.py: hái zi men zài gōng yuán lǐ tī zú qiú
items.en: The kids are playing football in the park.
items.why: The 在 place phrase must come before the verb, not after the object.

items.s: 他不在家，他在公司加班。
items.s_py: tā bù zài jiā tā zài gōng sī jiā bān
items.zh: 他不在家，他在公司加班。
items.py: tā bù zài jiā tā zài gōng sī jiā bān
items.en: He isn't at home, he's working overtime at the office.
items.why: 不在家 uses 在 as a main verb, and 在公司加班 uses 在 as a place marker. Both are correct.

items.s: 我们在吃完晚饭。
items.s_py: wǒ men zài chī wán wǎn fàn
items.zh: 我们在吃晚饭。
items.py: wǒ men zài chī wǎn fàn
items.en: We are having dinner.
items.why: A result complement like 完 means finished, which contradicts in-progress 在. The verb stays bare.

items.s: 你小声点，弟弟正在在客厅里写作业，他明天要考试。
items.s_py: nǐ xiǎo shēng diǎn dì di zhèng zài zài kè tīng lǐ xiě zuò yè tā míng tiān yào kǎo shì
items.zh: 你小声点，弟弟正在客厅里写作业，他明天要考试。
items.py: nǐ xiǎo shēng diǎn dì di zhèng zài kè tīng lǐ xiě zuò yè tā míng tiān yào kǎo shì
items.en: Keep it down, my younger brother is doing homework in the living room, he has an exam tomorrow.
items.why: One 在 does double duty as 'in progress' and 'at'. A doubled 正在在 is never said.

items.s: 小猫还在沙发上睡觉呢。
items.s_py: xiǎo māo hái zài shā fā shàng shuì jiào ne
items.zh: 小猫还在沙发上睡觉呢。
items.py: xiǎo māo hái zài shā fā shàng shuì jiào ne
items.en: The kitten is still asleep on the sofa.
items.why: 还 plus plain 在 plus final 呢 is a normal combination. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 我在写作业两个小时了。
items.s_py: wǒ zài xiě zuò yè liǎng ge xiǎo shí le
items.zh: 我写了两个小时的作业了。
items.py: wǒ xiě le liǎng ge xiǎo shí de zuò yè le
items.en: I've been doing homework for two hours.
items.why: 在 cannot take a duration. 'Have been doing for two hours' is verb + 了 + duration + 的 + object + 了.

items.s: 他已经在睡觉了，我们明天再给他打电话吧。
items.s_py: tā yǐ jīng zài shuì jiào le wǒ men míng tiān zài gěi tā dǎ diàn huà ba
items.zh: 他已经在睡觉了，我们明天再给他打电话吧。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng zài shuì jiào le wǒ men míng tiān zài gěi tā dǎ diàn huà ba
items.en: He is already asleep, let's call him tomorrow.
items.why: 已经在 + verb + 了 is correct and means 'is already at it'. The 了 belongs to the whole sentence.

items.s: 妈妈正在打扫过房间，你别进去。
items.s_py: mā ma zhèng zài dǎ sǎo guo fáng jiān nǐ bié jìn qù
items.zh: 妈妈正在打扫房间，你别进去。
items.py: mā ma zhèng zài dǎ sǎo fáng jiān nǐ bié jìn qù
items.en: Mum is cleaning the room, don't go in.
items.why: 正在 means the cleaning is under way, while 过 says it was done before. They cannot share a verb.

items.s: 我没有在看手机，我在看地图上的路线。
items.s_py: wǒ méi yǒu zài kàn shǒu jī wǒ zài kàn dì tú shàng de lù xiàn
items.zh: 我没有在看手机，我在看地图上的路线。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu zài kàn shǒu jī wǒ zài kàn dì tú shàng de lù xiàn
items.en: I'm not looking at my phone, I'm looking at the route on the map.
items.why: 没有在 is the full form of 没在 and correctly denies the first action. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 你为什么没正在听我说话？
items.s_py: nǐ wèi shén me méi zhèng zài tīng wǒ shuō huà
items.zh: 你为什么没在听我说话？
items.py: nǐ wèi shén me méi zài tīng wǒ shuō huà
items.en: Why aren't you listening to me?
items.why: 正 drops out after 没, so the form is 没在. 没正在 does not exist.

items.q: 医生___给病人检查身体，请你在外面等一下。
items.zh: 医生正在给病人检查身体，请你在外面等一下。
items.en: The doctor is examining a patient right now, so please wait outside.
items.why: 'Is doing right now' is 正在 straight before the verb phrase. 是 cannot stand for English 'is' before a verb, and 了 or 着 cannot fill that slot.
items.py: yī shēng zhèng zài gěi bìng rén jiǎn chá shēn tǐ qǐng nǐ zài wài miàn děng yí xià

items.q: 我妈妈现在___吃药，你过一会儿再打电话吧。
items.zh: 我妈妈现在在吃药，你过一会儿再打电话吧。
items.en: My mum is taking her medicine now, so call back in a while.
items.why: 现在 plus 在 before the verb says she is in the middle of taking it. 是 and 有 do not mark an action in progress, and 会 would mean 'will'.
items.py: wǒ mā ma xiàn zài zài chī yào nǐ guò yī huì r zài dǎ diàn huà ba

items.q: 他们也___用手机看比赛，没有人在看电视。
items.zh: 他们也在用手机看比赛，没有人在看电视。
items.en: They are watching the match on their phones too, and nobody is watching TV.
items.why: 也 comes before 在, and 在 goes straight before the verb phrase to say it is under way. 有 is not an 'is -ing' word, and 把 or 被 build different structures.
items.py: tā men yě zài yòng shǒu jī kàn bǐ sài méi yǒu rén zài kàn diàn shì

items.q: 我的电脑___更新系统，现在不能用。
items.zh: 我的电脑正在更新系统，现在不能用。
items.en: My computer is updating its system right now, so I can't use it.
items.why: 正在 before the verb says the update is going on at this moment, which explains 现在不能用. 是 and 有 do not mean 'is' in front of a verb.
items.py: wǒ de diàn nǎo zhèng zài gēng xīn xì tǒng xiàn zài bù néng yòng

items.q: 护士们都___给大家量体温，你们排好队，一个一个来。
items.zh: 护士们都在给大家量体温，你们排好队，一个一个来。
items.en: The nurses are all taking everyone's temperature now, so line up and come one at a time.
items.why: 都 comes before 在, then the verb phrase 给大家量体温. 是 cannot mean 'are' before a verb here, and 把 or 被 need a different structure.
items.py: hù shi men dōu zài gěi dà jiā liáng tǐ wēn nǐ men pái hǎo duì yí gè yí gè lái

items.q: 哥哥___修手机，你别去打扰他。
items.zh: 哥哥在修手机，你别去打扰他。
items.en: My brother is fixing his phone, so don't disturb him.
items.why: 在 before 修手机 gives 'is fixing right now', the reason not to disturb him. 会 would say he can fix phones, and 是 or 有 are not progressive markers.
items.py: gē ge zài xiū shǒu jī nǐ bié qù dǎ rǎo tā

items.q: 我们___听医生讲怎么锻炼身体，请你们别说话。
items.zh: 我们正在听医生讲怎么锻炼身体，请你们别说话。
items.en: We're listening to the doctor explain how to exercise, so please don't talk.
items.why: The moment-by-moment 'we are listening now' needs 正在 before 听. 是 is the typical English-driven slip, and 有 or 把 do not express an action in progress.
items.py: wǒ men zhèng zài tīng yī shēng jiǎng zěn me duàn liàn shēn tǐ qǐng nǐ men bié shuō huà

items.q: 别吵，爷爷睡觉___。
items.zh: 别吵，爷爷睡觉呢。
items.en: Don't make noise, Grandpa is sleeping.
items.why: Sentence-final 呢 says the action is going on right now, which is why 别吵. 吗 would make it a question, 过 means 'has done it before', and 吧 turns it into a suggestion.
items.py: bié chǎo yé ye shuì jiào ne

items.q: 我给手机充电___，等一会儿再玩。
items.zh: 我给手机充电呢，等一会儿再玩。
items.en: I'm charging my phone, I'll play in a bit.
items.why: Final 呢 marks that charging is under way. 吗 would ask a question, 过 says it happened before, and 得 cannot end a sentence.
items.py: wǒ gěi shǒu jī chōng diàn ne děng yī huì r zài wán

items.q: 医生在办公室看病人___，你先坐一下。
items.zh: 医生在办公室看病人呢，你先坐一下。
items.en: The doctor is seeing a patient in the office, please sit for a moment.
items.why: Ending on 呢 makes it 'is seeing a patient right now', which is why you must wait. 吗 turns it into a question, 过 into past experience, and 得 cannot close a sentence.
items.py: yī shēng zài bàn gōng shì kàn bìng rén ne nǐ xiān zuò yī xià

items.q: 我在手机上订机票___，马上就好。
items.zh: 我在手机上订机票呢，马上就好。
items.en: I'm booking a flight on my phone, it'll be done in a moment.
items.why: 呢 at the end shows the booking is going on now, matching 马上就好. 吧 suggests a guess, 吗 asks, and 过 would mean you did it once before.
items.py: wǒ zài shǒu jī shàng dìng jī piào ne mǎ shàng jiù hǎo

items.q: 小李在修电脑___，你过半个小时再找他。
items.zh: 小李在修电脑呢，你过半个小时再找他。
items.en: Xiao Li is fixing a computer, come find him in half an hour.
items.why: Final 呢 marks the repair as still going on, so come back later. 吗 asks a question, 过 says it happened before, and 得 cannot end a sentence.
items.py: xiǎo lǐ zài xiū diàn nǎo ne nǐ guò bàn gè xiǎo shí zài zhǎo tā

items.q: 他正在网上跟客服聊天___，所以现在没空接电话。
items.zh: 他正在网上跟客服聊天呢，所以现在没空接电话。
items.en: He is chatting online with customer service right now, so he has no time to answer the phone.
items.why: 呢 can close the clause 正在…聊天 and explains 现在没空. 吗 would turn the clause into a question, 过 puts the chat in the past, and 得 cannot end a clause.

items.q: 外面下雨___，你带一把伞吧。
items.zh: 外面下雨呢，你带一把伞吧。
items.en: It's raining outside, take an umbrella.
items.why: 呢 shows the rain is falling now, the reason to take an umbrella. 吗 would ask, 过 says it rained once before, and 得 cannot end a clause.
items.py: wài miàn xià yǔ ne nǐ dài yī bǎ sǎn ba

items.q: 我___在用手机，我在看书。
items.zh: 我没在用手机，我在看书。
items.en: I'm not using my phone, I'm reading.
items.why: An action in progress is negated with 没 + 在. 不正在 does not exist, 没呢在 is not a form, and 没有了在 cannot stand before a verb.
items.py: wǒ méi zài yòng shǒu jī wǒ zài kàn shū

items.q: 你在打游戏吗？___，我在写作业。
items.zh: 你在打游戏吗？没有，我在写作业。
items.en: Are you playing games? No, I'm doing my homework.
items.why: The short answer to a progressive question is 没有. 不正在 and 没正在 are not words, and 有 is never negated with 不.
items.py: nǐ zài dǎ yóu xì ma méi yǒu wǒ zài xiě zuò yè

items.q: 弟弟没___看电视，他在玩手机。
items.zh: 弟弟没在看电视，他在玩手机。
items.en: My brother isn't watching TV, he's on his phone.
items.why: 没 + 在 + verb negates an action in progress. 没正在 is impossible, 呢 does not follow 没, and 没…了 cannot be built this way.
items.py: dì di méi zài kàn diàn shì tā zài wán shǒu jī

items.q: 医生现在___看病人，你可以进去。
items.zh: 医生现在没在看病人，你可以进去。
items.en: The doctor isn't seeing patients right now, you can go in.
items.why: Not-in-progress is 没在 + verb. 不正在 does not exist, and 了 or 呢 cannot be attached to the negative.
items.py: yī shēng xiàn zài méi zài kàn bìng rén nǐ kě yǐ jìn qù

items.q: 昨天晚上你打电话的时候，我没___看比赛，我在洗衣服。
items.zh: 昨天晚上你打电话的时候，我没在看比赛，我在洗衣服。
items.en: When you called last night I wasn't watching the match, I was doing laundry.
items.why: Even in the past, the negative of 在看 is 没在看. 没正 and 没着 are not forms, and 没过 would mean 'have never'.
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang nǐ dǎ diàn huà de shí hou wǒ méi zài kàn bǐ sài wǒ zài xǐ yī fú

items.q: 手机没___充电，所以现在没电了。
items.zh: 手机没在充电，所以现在没电了。
items.en: The phone wasn't charging, so now it's out of battery.
items.why: 没在充电 negates the progressive. 正 cannot follow 没, and 呢 or 了 cannot sit between 没 and the verb.
items.py: shǒu jī méi zài chōng diàn suǒ yǐ xiàn zài méi diàn le

items.q: 请相信我，我___看你的手机，是它突然亮了。
items.zh: 请相信我，我没在看你的手机，是它突然亮了。
items.en: Believe me, I wasn't looking at your phone, it just lit up.
items.why: Negate an ongoing action with 没在 + verb. 不正在 and 没正在 are wrong, and 了 does not belong in the negative.
items.py: qǐng xiāng xìn wǒ wǒ méi zài kàn nǐ de shǒu jī shì tā tū rán liàng le

items.q: 他的手机没___响，是你的手机在响。
items.zh: 他的手机没在响，是你的手机在响。
items.en: His phone isn't ringing, it's yours that is ringing.
items.why: 没在响 negates 'is ringing'. 正 cannot come directly after 没, and 呢 or 着 cannot fill that position.
items.py: tā de shǒu jī méi zài xiǎng shì nǐ de shǒu jī zài xiǎng

items.q: 他进来的时候，我们___给老师发邮件。
items.zh: 他进来的时候，我们正在给老师发邮件。
items.en: When he came in, we were sending an email to the teacher.
items.why: A 的时候 clause sets the moment and 正在 says the action was going on then. The verb never takes 了, and 是 is not an 'is/was' marker.
items.py: tā jìn lái de shí hou wǒ men zhèng zài gěi lǎo shī fā yóu jiàn

items.q: 昨天晚上八点，我___看电视。
items.zh: 昨天晚上八点，我在看电视。
items.en: At eight o'clock last night I was watching TV.
items.why: The time word sets the moment, and 在 + verb says it was under way then. 了 would not fit before the verb, and 是 is not 'was' here.
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang bā diǎn wǒ zài kàn diàn shì

items.q: 明天下午三点你来的时候，医生可能___给别的病人看病，请你等一下。
items.zh: 明天下午三点你来的时候，医生可能正在给别的病人看病，请你等一下。
items.en: When you come tomorrow at three, the doctor may be seeing another patient, so please wait.
items.why: 正在 works for a future moment too, once a time phrase sets it. 了 or 过 cannot be attached to the progressive, and 着 cannot replace 正在.

items.q: 昨天你来的时候，我正在看___电视，没听见门铃。
items.zh: 昨天你来的时候，我正在看电视，没听见门铃。
items.en: When you came yesterday I was watching TV and didn't hear the bell.
items.why: After 正在 the verb stays bare. 了 would say the watching was completed, and 过 would say it happened once before, neither of which fits 'was in the middle of'.

items.q: 开会的时候，小王正在玩___手机，被老板看见了。

items.en: No, I'm looking up information.
items.why: 没有 is the standard short answer to 你在…吗？ when you deny what the person asked, and the correction is a positive 在 sentence.

items.zh: 昨天你来的时候，我正在看电视。
items.en: When you came yesterday I was watching TV.
items.why: 正在 means not finished, so the verb cannot carry 了. The past meaning comes from the time clause alone.

items.en: At three tomorrow afternoon I'll be at the hospital having a check-up, so I can't pick you up.
items.why: 正在 has no tense, so it works with a future time. The tempting 'it must be past' doubt is wrong.
